name: Awei T29P Wireless Bluetooth Earphones TWS ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Awei T29P True Wireless Bluetooth Earphones TWS

Experience superior sound, comfort, and convenience with the Awei T29P True Wireless Earbuds, designed for music, calls, and gaming on the go.

Key Features

Bluetooth 5.3: Ultra-stable wireless connection with low latency for seamless audio.

High-Fidelity 6mm Drivers: Enjoy crisp highs, clear mids, and deep bass for an immersive listening experience.

Long Battery Life:

Earbuds: Up to 6 hours of playtime per charge

Charging Case: Provides additional charges, extending total usage

Talk Time: Up to 7 hours

Standby Time: Approximately 300 hours

Fast Charging: Earbuds charge in 1.5 hours; charging case in 2 hours via Type-C interface.

IPX6 Water Resistance: Sweat and splash-proof, perfect for workouts and outdoor activities.

Touch Controls: Play/pause music, skip tracks, answer calls, and activate voice assistants with simple taps.

Transmission Range: Up to 10 meters for reliable connectivity.

Lightweight & Portable: Total weight ~35g with compact charging case (1.57 x 1.18 x 0.79 inches).
